checks.description: CloudTrail must be enabled in all regions to capture API activity across the entire AWS account
checks.impact: API activity in regions without CloudTrail coverage goes undetected, creating audit blind spots and hindering incident response
checks.resolution: Set is_multi_region_trail = true and include_global_service_events = true on the aws_cloudtrail resource
checks.errorMessage: CloudTrail is not enabled in all regions (is_multi_region_trail must be true)

checks.description: CloudTrail logging must not be explicitly disabled
checks.impact: Disabling CloudTrail logging halts all audit trail capture, removing visibility into account-wide API activity and violating compliance requirements
checks.resolution: Remove enable_logging = false or explicitly set enable_logging = true on the aws_cloudtrail resource
checks.errorMessage: CloudTrail has logging explicitly disabled (enable_logging must not be false)
